executive_summary: Episode 11 walks through the newly released probable cause indictment against Tyler James Robinson, with Candace Owens flagging missing timestamps in the Tyler-to-Lance text chain, omitted pre-scout footage referenced by Governor Cox, and the absence of a disassembled rifle. The episode also covers the George Zinn 'decoy' arrest, child abuse image charge, and exclusive Lance Twigs family allegations (kicked out junior year, Christmas vodka overdose, Easter drug episode, deep-web usage). Second half confronts Bill Ackman's 955-word tweet response to the Hamptons retreat allegations, plays Charlie Kirk's Megyn Kelly appearance from August 6, and discusses donor pressure and a building donor retraction in the 48 hours before Charlie's death.

claims.label: Robinson surrendered 33 hours after shooting
claims.claim: Tyler James Robinson surrendered to Washington County Sheriff's Office on September 11, 2025, approximately 33 hours after the shooting.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify surrender timestamp via sheriff's office records and forensic timeline.
claims.transcript_snippet: after 33 hours...Tyler James Robinson surrendered to police at Washington County Sheriff's Office

claims.label: DNA consistent with Robinson on rifle trigger
claims.claim: DNA consistent with Robinson was found on the rifle trigger and other parts of the rifle, plus fired cartridge casing and two of three unspent cartridges and the towel.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain forensic lab reports for chain of custody and match thresholds.
claims.transcript_snippet: the DNA was consistent with Robinson that was found on the trigger

claims.label: Suspect entered campus at 11:51am in dark American-flag shirt

claims.transcript_snippet: at approximately 11:51 a.m., the suspect had entered campus from the north

claims.claim: Surveillance camera covering the roof recorded an individual in dark clothing crossing the railing onto the roof at approximately 12:15pm, eight minutes before the 12:23pm shot.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check roof timestamp against shot-time audio forensics.
